fixes.production_host_allocator: Direct opt-in reclaiming ResourceManager synchronized allocator exposes its refundable owner and backing without replacing the allocation path. Host and statement quotas, owned reservation credit and all pins remain authoritative. Ordinary/opaque/region paths retain conservative caching.
fixes.generic_residency: Stable allocation-free round-robin owner registry; callbacks use nonblocking known-lock acquisition. Only refundable reclamation can reuse locks held by the current thread. Host teardown asserts no hooks remain.
fixes.single_threaded: SMP allocator identity comparison is compiled only in threaded builds. Page-allocator-only native probe compiles and executes with -fsingle-threaded. Full WASM bundle not built.
fixes.covering_ranges: Immutable authenticated cache/physical response leases remove intermediate owned stripe payload copies. Cached units still use admitVerifiedBlock and persistent raw-unit cache identities. Decoded cache retains independent framing. Uncached wave responses use independent reference-counted owners with stable caller allocators. Owning range API remains available.

native_drain_measurement.fixture: 8192 rows, eight 128-byte string columns with independent ordinal/column tags. 64-row input cohorts interleave ascending ranks; every sorted key and value tag checked.
native_drain_measurement.allocator_chain: sql_memory_owner.create -> actual ResourceManager reclaiming synchronized host allocator -> SQL statement Budget -> spill.Manager
native_drain_measurement.timing: Debug native thread CPU; setup/add and Sort.finish excluded, first page, complete drain and independent oracles included. Six alternating Snappy pairs follow one warmup per policy per codec. Task-owned build, E2E and cleanup do not overlap timing; other host activity uncontrolled.
native_drain_measurement.tradeoff: Adaptive residency uses spare evictable memory under the same limits. No peak RSS, cloud, HTTP, archive, whole-query or whole-publication throughput claim. The older 8.68x bare-allocator result remains historical and is not attributed to this source.

leased_range_measurement.fixture: 2 MiB pseudorandom payload, 32 adjacent 64 KiB authenticated logical units; complete digest and every byte checked. Owning and leased paths include the identical simulated decoded-owner wire copy.
leased_range_measurement.provider: Instrumented real filesystem ArtifactStore; one identical 2 MiB range GET cold; cached warm zero GETs; uncached repeated reads one GET.
leased_range_measurement.metric: Requested caller allocation bytes, excluding backend cache allocations. Not peak memory, CPU or whole-query throughput. Cached and uncached admission have exhaustive allocation-failure coverage.
leased_range_measurement.decoded_cache: Savings apply to decoded-cache misses, including raw-cache-warm input. Decoded-cache hits already skip the wire path.
